tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Create a Pool Pro Florida service lead in Pool Founder when a customer is interested in service but is not yet booking an appointment. Do not call this before book_appointment for the same inquiry because a successful Cal.com booking creates the Pool Founder lead through the booking webhook.

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Get real Cal.com appointment availability for Pool Pro Florida. Use date-only YYYY-MM-DD values. Use this when a customer wants to schedule a pool consultation or service appointment.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed Pool Pro Florida appointment through Cal.com after the customer has selected an available time. Requires customer name, email, service address, and the exact start value returned by get_available_times. A successful booking triggers the existing Cal.com webhook, which creates the le

tools.name: get_site_map
tools.description: Read the current PoolProFlorida.com sitemap index and discover published site pages. Use this to find the correct Pool Pro Florida page before reading current website content. An optional query ranks likely relevant page URLs first.

tools.name: read_site_page
tools.description: Read the current text of a PoolProFlorida.com page. The page must be present in the current Pool Pro Florida sitemap index. Use this for current published services, pricing, service areas, hours, policies, and page-specific business information.

tools.name: upsert_customer_contact
tools.description: Create or update one private Pool Pro Florida CardDAV contact from Pool Founder. Owner-only and non-destructive: this tool never removes any other contacts.

tools.name: upsert_route_stop_event
tools.description: Create or update one private Pool Pro Florida CalDAV VEVENT from a Pool Founder route stop. The identity is jobId plus serviceDate, so planned timing can later be replaced by actual arrival and departure without duplication. Owner-only and non-destructive.

tools.name: sync_route_calendar
tools.description: Synchronize one complete Pool Founder route-date window into the private Pool Pro Florida CalDAV calendar. Each stop is one stable VEVENT. Completed events are historical records and are never removed. Missing non-completed events inside a validated complete window are retained and marked cancelled

tools.name: sync_customer_contacts
tools.description: Replace the private Pool Pro Florida CardDAV address book from one complete Pool Founder active-customer snapshot. Owner-only. Creates and updates stable vCards and removes stale Pool Founder contacts only after the complete snapshot validates.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_site_map · Private data: upsert_customer_contact, upsert_route_stop_event, sync_route_calendar, sync_customer_contacts · Public sink: create_lead, book_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_site_map · Private data: upsert_customer_contact, upsert_route_stop_event, sync_route_calendar, sync_customer_contacts · Public sink: create_lead, book_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
